title: The Real Cost of Owning a Porsche 918
description:
A Porsche nine eighteen Spyder cost eight hundred forty-five thousand dollars new. One sold in twenty twenty-six for nearly three million. And the people who publish its running costs disagree about almost everything: a replacement battery is quoted at fifty to eighty thousand dollars by one source, and eighty to one hundred fifty thousand by another. This is what it really costs to own a Porsche nine eighteen, and what nobody has actually published. We read Wikipedia, Porsche's own press material, two specialist guides, the recall reports, and the auction results. Here is the catch. Porsche publishes no price list for nine eighteen service, and the two guides we found are a magazine-style buyer's guide and a repair shop's marketing page. So every running-cost figure in this video is an estimate from someone, and we always say whose.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
